fields.label: Quality Assurance & Control
fields.description: This Quality Assurance & Control (QAC) form shall be completed for each timber framed floor, to ensure conformance with approved standard NZS 3604:2011. The form shall be stored electronically in the project folder, and as a hard copy in the site QAC folder.

fields.label: Is the site wind zone confirmed as suitable for direct fix (generally up to Extra High per James Hardie specification)?
Is framing straight, plumb, dry, and compliant with NZS 3604 tolerances?
Is approved flexible wall underlay installed correctly with proper laps, fixing, and penetrations sealed?
Are studs spaced correctly (typically max 600mm centres unless engineering specifies otherwise)?
Is minimum 150mm clearance to finished ground and 50mm to paved surfaces maintained?
Are specified corrosion-resistant nails or screws used (correct class for exposure zone)?
Are fasteners installed at correct centres to studs and sheet edges per wind zone requirement?
Are vertical joints (PVC/aluminium jointers or expressed detail) installed correctly and aligned?
Are head flashings, sill flashings, meter boxes, pipes, and other penetrations flashed and sealed per specification?

payload.name: QA SVS Ecoply+Cavity
payload.description: Blank reusable template transcribed from supplied example reports.

fields.label: Correct Ecoply Barrier installed with coated face facing outward. Panels undamaged and dry.
Panels fixed with approved fasteners. Edge fixings max. 150 mm centres, intermediate fixings max. 300 mm centres (or as specified for wind zone/bracing).
All sheet edges fully supported by framing. Vertical sheet joints have 2–3 mm expansion gap.
Bottom sheet overhangs bottom plate 25–40 mm and required ground clearances maintained.
Vertical joints, internal/external corners and window/door jambs taped with approved Ecoply sealing tape.
Horizontal sheet joints protected with approved Z flashing or specified sealing tape.
Window and door sill flashing tape installed correctly.
Service penetrations sealed with approved flexible tape. No unsealed holes or gaps.
Correct cavity batten type and thickness installed to specification (typically minimum 18 mm cavity where required).
Battens straight, plumb and securely fixed into framing only.
Fasteners penetrate framing adequately and do not damage Ecoply Barrier.
Battens positioned to maintain continuous drainage path from top to bottom.
Vermin closer/base closure installed where specified.
Battens correctly terminated around windows, doors and flashings without blocking drainage.
Flashings remain unobstructed and water can discharge freely over flashings.
No crushed, split or loose battens. Damaged battens replaced.
Ventilation openings at top and bottom of cavity remain clear.
